title: Pickle Mosaic Surreal Portrait
description: A large cracked mosaic-style portrait of a man's face dominates the composition, constructed from purple, pink, and yellow tiles with circular patterns. Oversized green pickles float throughout the scene, overlapping the face and surrounding several retro pin-up women in various poses, some partially nude, set against a dark abstract background.
prompt: Surreal mosaic portrait of a man's face made from cracked purple, pink and yellow tiles with circular patterns, large green pickles floating across the composition, surrounded by retro 1950s pin-up women in red and white lingerie posing seductively, dark atmospheric background, bizarre dreamlike collage, detailed painting style
